reason: E2 supports that Al addition causes FCC-to-BCC transformation and enhances creep resistance, and that creep resistance peaks then declines with Al content, consistent with an optimum near 0.7. However, E2 does not address corrosion resistance or oxide formation, and E1 is about a different alloy system (Ti-V-Nb-Ta) and provides no support for any premise. The corrosion premise is entirely unsupported by cited evidence.
premises: Al addition to CoCrFeNiCu transforms FCC to BCC
Al addition enhances nanoscale creep resistance in CoCrFeNi-based HEAs
Al content around 0.7 mol ratio optimizes creep resistance in AlxCoCrFeNi
BCC phase formation reduces strain rate sensitivity and room-temperature creep
Al promotes a protective oxide layer for improved corrosion resistance
